title_en: Fall 2026 Graduation Project (Electrical Engineering Design Project): Second Interim Presentation
summary: Students taking the Fall 2026 Graduation Project (Electrical Engineering Design Project) must attend the second interim presentation on Thursday, October 8, at 18:30, in the classroom assigned to their module. Attendance is taken exactly at the start time, and students should check the email sent to them with the notice and their module assignment. The final (4th) poster presentation session has been moved from Thursday, November 19 to Friday, November 20.
applies_to: Students taking the Fall 2026 Graduation Project (Electrical Engineering Design Project) who submitted a meeting confirmation form. Attendance is checked; unexcused lateness and absence are to be avoided.

dates.what: Second interim presentation of the Graduation Project (all modules)
Attendance check at the second interim presentation (taken exactly at the start time)
Final (4th) poster presentation session of the Graduation Project (rescheduled; previously Thursday, November 19)

conditions: Attendance is checked exactly at the start time; avoid unexcused lateness or absence.
If you cannot attend for reasons such as reserve forces (예비군) training or an academic conference, you must inform the department office in advance.
Notices and module assignments are sent only to the email address written on your meeting confirmation form.
If you did not receive the email, you must inform the department office.
The final poster presentation session is no longer on November 19; it is on Friday, November 20.
steps: Check the email address you wrote on your meeting confirmation form for the notice and your module assignment.
If you did not receive the email, inform the department office (Building 301, Room 308); the contact details are in the original notice.
If you wrote a non-SNU address (for example, Naver Mail) and want to change it to your SNU account, notify the department office by email.
If you cannot attend because of reserve forces training, an academic conference or a similar reason, inform the department office in advance.
Check the related notice on the final poster session date change (https://ece.snu.ac.kr/community/academics?md=v&bbsidx=57944) and the email about it.

On Thursday, October 8, arrive before 18:30 at your module's room: Semiconductor 1 – Room 202; Semiconductor 2 – Room 818; Electrical Energy – Room 103; Electrophysics – Room 104; Communications – Room 201; Control – Room 302; Computer 1 – Room 102; Computer 2 – Room 118; Bio – Room 106 (the building for these rooms is not stated in the notice).
translation:
[Fall 2026] Graduation Project (Electrical Engineering Design Project) – Second Interim Presentation

The second interim presentation of the Graduation Project will take place on Thursday, October 8.

We have sent the notice and your module assignment to the email address you wrote on your submitted meeting confirmation form, so please check it. Students who did not receive the email must inform the staff member in charge at the department office (contact details are in the original notice).

Emails are being sent to the address written on the meeting confirmation form. If you wrote an address such as Naver Mail and wish to change it to your SNU account, please let us know by email.

Attendance will be checked exactly at the start time, so please take care not to be late or absent without notice. (If you have difficulty attending for reasons such as reserve forces (예비군) training or an academic conference, please let me [the department office staff member] know.)

In addition, the schedule of the 4th session, the final poster presentation, has changed from 11.19 (Thu) to 11.20 (Fri), so please check the related schedule as well. (Check your email.)
https://ece.snu.ac.kr/community/academics?md=v&bbsidx=57944
